notes: Added public IPv6 remote play with one-tap address copy and an automatic check of whether remote play is possible, falling back to a LAN-only notice otherwise; the LAN host now picks the board and rules, and each AI takes its own algorithm; fixed AI moves being dropped on clients and fixed the Linux desktop build
notes_zh: 新增公网 IPv6 远程联机（一键复制地址，自动判断能否跨网络，否则提示只能局域网）、局域网联机支持房主自选棋盘与规则、每个 AI 独立选算法；修复 AI 落子被客户端忽略导致卡住、修复 Linux 桌面版构建失败
